> **Sample post — replace or revise before publishing.** This is a conceptual reflection, not a report of empirical findings.

In a spoken survey item, the full recording may not always be necessary before a respondent can identify what is being asked. This raises a measurement question: at what point has enough meaning been communicated to support a response?

Possible research approaches include structured human judgments, AI-assisted evaluations, and comparisons with observed response timing. Each approach raises questions about reliability, validity, and generalizability.
